parts.says: A knot is a bump the hand can feel, beneath the skin
parts.short: be a bump beneath the skin

parts.says: When a knot lets go its bump goes with it, as a contraction letting go
parts.short: let its bump go like an unclenching

parts.says: Pressing or rolling can bring a knot out, over minutes
parts.short: bring a knot out by rolling
parts.not_run: it needs a rolling trial in every theory

parts.says: A slow out-breath lets the easiest knots go, during an out-breath
parts.short: let an easy knot go on the out-breath

parts.says: One relaxing breath lets three or more knots go, within that breath
parts.short: let three or more go in one relaxing breath

parts.says: Deep knots hold through 30 relaxing breaths, and let go to focused attention and breath within 30
parts.short: keep deep knots through calm breathing and let them go to focus

parts.says: Release can be broad (spread across the patch) and focused (most of it at one place)
parts.short: release both broadly and at one place

parts.says: Under one way of breathing, some knots go by the 2nd breath and others from the 3rd to the 30th
parts.short: let easy knots go in a breath or two and hard ones over many

parts.says: Pressure and attention at one place let knots go there, few elsewhere
parts.short: release one place at a time under a hand

parts.says: Pressed, with a slow out-breath, at least half of knots let go within seconds: under the hand or as it eases off
parts.short: let a pressed knot go within seconds of breathing out

parts.says: Drinking water eases release, and speeds it
parts.short: answer to water

parts.says: More stress holds more knots
parts.short: hold more knots under more stress

parts.says: Knots gather where stress is held
parts.short: gather knots where stress is held

parts.says: Under breath and mood, a knot forms and lets go at least twice in an hour
parts.short: let knots come and go with breath and mood

parts.says: A knot forms and lets go within a single breath
parts.short: form and release a knot within one breath

parts.says: Knots limit movement; a stretch meets them as dull, deep blocks
parts.short: limit movement
parts.not_run: it needs the mechanics stage (stiffness and stretch)

parts.says: A release brings, within seconds, a brief sensation confined to the knot's own place
parts.short: spark at the knot's own place as it goes

parts.says: After one knot lets go, a new one forms nearby within minutes
parts.short: form a new knot nearby after a release

parts.says: Sometimes, after a knot lets go, a knot is back in the same or a similar spot within 10 minutes
parts.short: put a knot back in the same spot after a release

parts.says: Releasing one knot lets three or more others go with it, within seconds
parts.short: let three or more go with one

parts.says: The unit exists at dozens per square inch and about 100,000 in a body
parts.short: have a unit as dense as micro knots

parts.says: Working one side eases the other
parts.short: ease the other side
parts.not_run: it needs the body stage (both sides)

parts.says: A knot held briefly lets go when its stress ends; one held for hours persists
parts.short: let a brief knot go and keep an old one

parts.says: Knots accumulate with age
parts.short: accumulate knots with age
parts.not_run: it needs the body stage (a life's accumulation)

notes.O3: Nothing in the vessel switch turns on hydration.
notes.O15: Small vessels rise to the skin on the order of 100,000, one every 4-5 mm (estimated from the skin's area); the major ones, 374 on average (taylor1987).
notes.O1.3: Through drive alone the breath is not local, so focusing it changes nothing; through movement, focus concentrates the movement at the place; aimed, it lowers the drive there.
notes.O2.2: Pressed, the vessel is squeezed and cannot open: it lets go within a second of the hand lifting, not under it.
notes.O8.1: A release lowers the pressure its siblings share, by several mmHg, but not enough to shut one; a neighbour shuts only if something else pushes on it by 10 mmHg or more (exploratory/2026-09-27-migration-pressure.py), where tissue pressure under the skin rises only a few mmHg as it fills (christ1997).
notes.O10.1: Without adaptation nothing remembers how long a knot was held; with it, a knot held for hours can set and hold at rest (findings 003).
notes.O17.1: The account places the felt knot at the fascial ring and gives it no bump: a shut vessel leaves its patch with less blood, nothing firmer. Feeding the muscle beneath, it could make one, slow to go (PLAN.md finding 17).
notes.O17.2: A vessel reopening floods its patch (a flush, a tingle) rather than unclenching.

notes.O3: Nothing in the energy crisis turns on hydration.
notes.O10.1: Its slow sustaining factors (weeks) are not modelled yet.
notes.O15: Hundreds of sites, a few regions in each muscle (300 taken as representative); the active nidus is 1-2 mm (hubbard1993).
notes.O8.1: New knots after a release come from the taut band's load shifting to its neighbours: an extension of the account.
notes.O2.2: Pressure release takes tens of seconds (60-90 s at the pressures used, pecosmartin2019), not one out-breath.
notes.O4.2: Which endplates hold a knot is set more by their own activity than by where stress is held.
notes.O17.1: The contraction knot in a taut band, stiffer than its surroundings (sikdar2009): a bump in muscle.
notes.O17.2: It lets go as the contracture relaxes, over tens of seconds under a press.

variants.name: arousal
variants.description: the breath eases arousal and is felt as safety; attention and pressure act on what is felt at a place

notes.O3: Nothing in the account turns on hydration.
notes.O15: The account has no unit to count: knots are places made tender, as many as the body map resolves.
notes.O6: Its tingling comes from overbreathing, in the hands, face and trunk at once (macefield1991), not at a release.
notes.O1.1: Its easy knots fade on the in-breath, when pain is felt less (arsenault2013), not on the out-breath.
notes.O2.2: A press adds input and draws attention, so a pressed knot is felt more: it fades, if at all, when the hand lifts, not under it.
notes.O17.1: Nothing in the tissue changes: the bump is an ordinary structure made tender, felt as a knot.
notes.O17.2: What goes is what is felt; nothing lets go in the tissue.

variants.name: excite
variants.description: a hand excites the units it presses; attention inhibits them

variants.name: inhibit
variants.description: a hand excites for a moment, then inhibits while held; attention inhibits

notes.O3: Nothing in the motor switch turns on hydration.
notes.O6: The account says nothing of a tingle at a release; its units, falling silent, unclench.
notes.O15: No count until the number of motor units in a body is sourced.
notes.O17.1: A latched unit keeps its patch of muscle contracted, beneath the skin: a bump the hand can feel.
notes.O17.2: It lets go when the unit falls silent, and the contraction goes at once: an unclenching.
notes.O10.1: Nothing in the switch remembers how long a knot was held, once its loop has built (minutes).
